mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, post_id, publisher_id, receiver_id, amount, status, pay_status, pay_gateway, pay_no, pay_time, refund_time, remark, confirm_time, finish_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason, create_time, update_time FROM trade_order WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, order_no, post_id, publisher_id, receiver_id, amount, status, pay_status, pay_gateway, pay_no, pay_time, refund_time, remark, confirm_time, finish_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason, create_time, update_time FROM trade_order WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_no, post_id, publisher_id, receiver_id, amount, status, pay_status, pay_gateway, pay_no, pay_time, refund_time, remark, confirm_time, finish_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason, create_time, update_time FROM trade_order WHERE ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM trade_order WHERE status = 2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_order (order_no, post_id, publisher_id, receiver_id, amount, status, pay_status, pay_gateway, pay_no, pay_time, refund_time, remark, confirm_time, finish_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{postId}, #{publisherId}, #{receiverId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{payStatus}, #{payGateway}, #{payNo}, #{payTime}, #{refundTime}, #{remark}, #{confirmTime}, #{finishTime}, #{cancelTime}, #{cancelReason}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE trade_order SET order_no = #{orderNo}, post_id = #{postId}, publisher_id = #{publisherId}, receiver_id = #{receiverId}, amount = #{amount}, status = #{status}, pay_status = #{payStatus}, pay_gateway = #{payGateway}, pay_no = #{payNo}, pay_time = #{payTime}, refund_time = #{refundTime}, remark = #{remark}, confirm_time = #{confirmTime}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, cancel_time = #{cancelTime}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
